definition: An attack uses many systems to flood a target and prevent legitimate access.
The application layer handles requests such as web queries that can be flooded during an attack.
An Elastic IP is an account-allocated public address whose associated resources can receive Shield Advanced protection.
A web ACL groups rules that inspect web requests and determine their treatment.
A health check reports whether a resource meets configured availability criteria.
A mitigation is a measure that reduces the impact of attack traffic on an application.
